signals.signal: Open tender 'Доставка на машини ... Обмяна на каса на банкноти и монети от левове в евро, чрез пощенски станции' — banknote- and coin-counting machines to run the lev-to-euro cash exchange service across the post-office network. Estimated BGN 2,670,500 excl. VAT over 5 lots; BGN 2,613,750 awarded, ALL four tendered lots to a single supplier ОБС ТРЕЙД ООД (OBS Trade): Lot1 banknote counters type1 BGN 1,160,250; Lot2 banknote counters type2 BGN 282,750; Lot4 coin counters type1 BGN 1,114,750; Lot5 coin counters type2 BGN 56,000. Lot3 split off under art.21(6) ZOP. EOP contract page app.eop.bg/today/439815; EOP buyer profile app.eop.bg/buyer/14878.
signals.source_name: TED notice 420954-2025 (contract award notice, OJ S 122/2025), notice PDF
signals.implies: The single largest euro-changeover cash-automation hardware award in Bulgaria went to a local competitor, not Printec. Printec's cash automation / counting-and-sorting line lost the post-office channel; the installed OBS Trade fleet now becomes a multi-year service-and-maintenance annuity that Printec can attack at renewal, and a reference point for pricing against Printec managed services.
signals.likelihood: Maintenance/spares follow-on likely to surface within 6-12 months as the fleet beds in
signals.followup: Watch EOP buyer profile app.eop.bg/buyer/14878 and TED for a Bulgarian Posts maintenance/spares tender on the counting fleet; identify OBS Trade's OEM (likely Glory/Ratiotec-class) to position a Printec service alternative.

signals.entity: Българска народна банка (BNB, Bulgarian National Bank)
signals.signal: Award 'Поддръжка и адаптация на касова техника по обособени позиции' — maintenance and EURO ADAPTATION of BNB cash equipment, 4 lots, explicitly tied to euro adoption. Total awarded EUR 87,370.09. Lot1: 3-year subscription maintenance of TEN SOUTH Automation EvoSort H9 coin-sorting machines for euro coins → ЕТ ХРИСТО ЦОНКОВСКИ, EUR 51,170.09 (contract 236076, 23/01/2026). Lot2: software re-programming/adaptation of one Giesecke+Devrient BPS M7 banknote-processing machine for euro banknotes → Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH, EUR 36,200.00 (contract 236081, 30/01/2026). Lot3 (SOUTH Automation Coin Packing Line adaptation, BGN 1,100) and Lot4 (3x SELEX SIRIO 30 coin packers, BGN 15,209.46) direct-awarded. Only ONE tender received per competed lot. EOP contract page app.eop.bg/today/533073.
signals.source_name: TED notice 83221-2026 (contract award notice, OJ S 25/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: Maps the BNB cash-centre equipment estate Printec would have to service: G+D BPS M7 banknote processors plus SOUTH Automation EvoSort H9 coin sorters and SELEX SIRIO 30 coin packers. Incumbent service position is split between a sole trader (ЕТ Христо Цонковски) and the OEM (G+D). Single-bidder lots signal a thin competitive field — a credible multi-OEM managed-service bid from Printec could break it at renewal (Lot1 runs 3 years to Jan 2029).
signals.likelihood: No new BNB cash-equipment tender in the next 6-12 months; renewal window is 2028-29
signals.followup: Register on BNB's EOP buyer profile app.eop.bg/buyer/11700 for alerts; build a SOUTH Automation / SELEX service capability case ahead of the 2029 Lot1 renewal.

signals.signal: Direct award (negotiated without prior call) 'Доставка и инсталиране на модули и М-сензори за обработка на евробанкноти за банкнотообработващи машини BPS C5/C7' — 2x MFDSTAR+ Level-3 M-sensors plus 2x MFM modules for euro-banknote authentication on BPS C5/C7. Estimated EUR 184,500 excl. VAT; awarded EUR 181,000 to Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH; contract БНБ-102152 of 22/06/2026. Justified as ECB-accredited sole source under art.79(1)(3)(c) ZOP, backed by AOP control opinion Д-121/30.10.2025.
signals.source_name: TED notice 436046-2026 (contract award notice, OJ S 120/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: Level-3 euro-banknote authentication sensors are a closed ECB-accredited market (G+D and OeBS only) — structurally NOT addressable by Printec. Useful as a hard boundary for account planning: at BNB, Printec should target the surrounding layers (managed services, logistics, security systems, IT) not the sensor/sorter core. Mirrors the same G+D direct-award pattern the baseline logged at HNB Croatia.
signals.likelihood: Further G+D direct awards at BNB highly likely as the euro fleet is completed
signals.followup: Treat BPS-family sensor/module supply as out-of-scope; monitor for the surrounding service and spares lots instead.

signals.signal: Direct award 'Доставка и инсталиране на М-сензори за обработка на евробанкноти по обособени позиции', 2 lots — Lot1 five sets of Level-3 M-sensors for BPS M7, Lot2 modules for BPS C5 plus M-sensors for BPS C4 and BPS C5. Estimated EUR 1,880,000 excl. VAT; total awarded EUR 1,771,317.00 to Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH. Justification text confirms the machines are used by BNB AND by ДКУ АД (Дружество за касови услуги), which will keep processing lev and euro banknotes on BNB's behalf, and that ECB authorisations were issued 06/08/2025 to G+D and Oesterreichische Banknoten- und Sicherheitsdruck GmbH.
signals.source_name: TED notice 869074-2025 (contract award notice, OJ S 252/2025), notice PDF
signals.implies: Sizes the BNB euro cash-processing capex at ~EUR 1.77m for sensors alone and, more usefully, names ДКУ АД as the outsourced operator of Bulgaria's banknote processing. ДКУ АД is bank-owned and private, so it never appears on EOP — Printec must approach it as a direct commercial account for cash automation, recyclers and managed cash services rather than waiting for a tender.
signals.likelihood: ДКУ АД equipment refresh decisions taken commercially, not via EOP; engagement possible any time
signals.followup: Open a direct commercial approach to ДКУ АД (dku.bg, EIK 175327305) on cash automation and managed cash services — it is invisible to tender monitoring by design.

signals.signal: OPEN tender 'Доставка и внедряване на информационна система за управление на електронни документи' — supply and implementation of an electronic document management system incl. licences, installation, roll-out, staff training and warranty support. Estimated EUR 773,150 excl. VAT. Open procedure; deadline for receipt of tenders 13/08/2026 23:59:59. EOP buyer profile app.eop.bg/buyer/11700.
signals.source_name: TED notice 484925-2026 (contract notice, OJ S 133/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: A live, sizeable central-bank IT tender closing in under two weeks. Adjacent rather than core to Printec's line, but it fits digital onboarding/document-workflow and managed-services capability and is a route into the BNB vendor list — currently held by ТехноЛогика, Сирма and БОРИКА on the IT side.
signals.followup: Bid/no-bid within days; if no-bid, approach the likely winner (ТехноЛогика/Сирма class) as a partner for document-capture and eKYC components.

signals.signal: Tender 'Доставка и поддръжка на системи за сигурност в обекти на БНБ по обособени позиции' — supply and maintenance of security systems across BNB sites in TEN lots: access-control components, CCTV components, metal-detector frames and hand-held detectors, spare components, plus out-of-warranty maintenance of access control at the BNB Cash Centre Plovdiv and BNB Sofia buildings, visitor-registration system, and physical-protection equipment at the Plovdiv and Sofia cash centres. Restricted procedure; total estimated EUR 262,600 excl. VAT (lot values seen include EUR 156,000 / 82,500 / 25,000 / 24,100 / 3,544). Deadline for requests to participate 04/06/2026; as of 01/08/2026 NO award notice has appeared on TED.
signals.source_name: TED notice 303058-2026 (contract notice, OJ S 85/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: Confirms BNB is refreshing physical security around its cash centres (Sofia and the new Plovdiv cash centre) in the euro era — the security/managed-services envelope around cash handling that Printec can serve. Award still pending, so the winner list is the near-term intelligence prize.
signals.likelihood: Award expected within 6 months; next cycle is the realistic entry point
signals.followup: Re-check TED and app.eop.bg/buyer/11700 monthly for the award notice and capture the 10 lot winners as the BNB security incumbent map.

signals.signal: Contract modification notice for 'Предоставяне на услуги по охрана на имущество и транспортиране на ценни пратки и пощенски товари' — guarding of property and transport of valuables/cash across the postal network. Value of all contracts in the notice EUR 43,985,589.75, holder ВИП СЕКЮРИТИ ЕООД (VIP Security). CPV 79713000. EOP contract page app.eop.bg/today/202977.
signals.source_name: TED notice 342170-2026 (contract modification notice, OJ S 95/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: Sizes Bulgaria's largest public cash-in-transit / valuables-logistics contract at ~EUR 44m and names VIP Security as the incumbent carrying the post-office cash chain through the euro changeover. Printec does not do armoured transport, but this is the partner (or gatekeeper) for any end-to-end cash-cycle or smart-safe/recycler proposition into the 2,700-plus post-office network, and it is being repeatedly amended rather than re-tendered.
signals.likelihood: Repeated modifications suggest no open re-tender in the next 6-12 months
signals.followup: Approach ВИП СЕКЮРИТИ ЕООД as a channel partner for cash-recycling/smart-safe technology into the postal network rather than bidding against it.

signals.entity: Национална агенция за приходите (NRA) / БОРИКА АД
signals.signal: Contract modification for 'Обслужване на картови плащания на публични задължения... чрез виртуално терминално устройство ПОС или чрез терминални устройства ПОС' — card-payment acceptance for tax and social-security liabilities via virtual POS and PHYSICAL POS terminals in NRA offices, including terminal supply, configuration, servicing, PIN pads and interchange fees. Value of all contracts in the notice EUR 9,381,606.79; holder БОРИКА АД. EOP contract page app.eop.bg/today/527040.
signals.source_name: TED notice 34312-2026 (contract modification notice, OJ S 11/2026), notice PDF
signals.implies: Bulgaria's largest public-sector POS acquiring contract, held by BORICA AD — the domestic card processor. Directly overlaps Printec's POS/acquiring line. BORICA also holds the Customs Agency, Road Infrastructure Agency and Ministry of e-Government card-acceptance contracts, i.e. it has effectively swept public-sector acquiring. Any Printec POS play in Bulgaria is a play through or against BORICA.
signals.likelihood: Re-tender not visible in the next 6-12 months; contract keeps being extended by modification
signals.followup: Position Printec as a terminal-estate and managed-services supplier TO BORICA rather than a competing acquirer; map the physical POS fleet model used in NRA offices.

signals.entity: Министерство на електронното управление (Ministry of e-Government) / БОРИКА АД
signals.signal: Contract modification for 'Приемане и обслужване на картови плащания... наредени чрез виртуално терминално устройство ПОС' — virtual-POS card acceptance (bCard, VISA, MasterCard, Diners Club, Discover) integrated into the ministry's national e-payment system. Value of all contracts in the notice EUR 511,291.88; holder БОРИКА АД. EOP contract page app.eop.bg/today/285828 (procedure internal id 285828).
signals.source_name: TED notice 451922-2026 (contract modification notice, OJ S 124/2026), notice PDF

Confirms the public-sector acquiring lock-in and marks the e-payment gateway as a partnership target for Printec digital-payments and eKYC components, not a tender target.

signals.followup: Monitor egov.government.bg e-Плащане module roadmap for component-level subcontracting opportunities.

signals.signal: Open tender 'Абонаментна гаранционна и извънгаранционна поддръжка и сервиз на банкнотоброячни машини, принтери и многофункционални устройства' for the 22 offices of the Municipal Revenue Directorate — maintenance of banknote-counting machines and counterfeit-banknote detectors. Estimated BGN 150,000 excl. VAT. Launched 16/07/2025 (TED 463847-2025); the result notice of 23/02/2026 records 'No winner was chosen and the competition is closed' — 2 tenders received but only one admissible. EOP buyer profile app.eop.bg/buyer/1240. As of 01/08/2026 no replacement tender for this CPV has appeared from Sofia Municipality on TED.
signals.source_name: TED notices 463847-2025 and 126503-2026 (contract notice + result notice), notice PDFs
signals.implies: A failed competition on a cash-counting maintenance contract that Sofia Municipality still needs — the requirement has not gone away and a re-tender is the natural next step. Small but a clean, low-barrier entry point for Printec cash-automation service in Bulgaria's largest municipality, with a demonstrated shortage of qualified bidders.
signals.likelihood: Re-tender plausible within 6-12 months given the service is still required
signals.followup: Set an alert on app.eop.bg/buyer/1240 and TED CPV 50310000 for Столична община; pre-position with the Municipal Revenue Directorate before re-launch.

signals.signal: ZERO ATM, cash-recycler, CDM or self-service-terminal tenders found in Bulgarian public procurement for 2025-2026. Verified by TED full-text search restricted to buyer-country=BGR for 'банкомат' (10 hits 2025+, all cash-collection/e-voting/lottery contracts that merely mention ATMs as a payment channel), and by 'устройство за самообслужване' OR 'АТМ' OR 'ресайклър' OR 'cash recycler' from 01/01/2025 which returned TOTAL=0. CPV sweep of 30123200 (ATMs) for Bulgaria from 01/06/2025 also returned no ATM notices. Cause: Bulgarian commercial banks and the interbank cash-services company ДКУ АД are private entities outside the Public Procurement Act, so ATM/recycler buying never reaches EOP or TED.
signals.source_name: TED Search API v3 (api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search), expert queries run 01/08/2026
signals.implies: Confirms the two prior nil returns from EOP were correct, not a search failure — and explains WHY. Printec should stop treating EOP as an ATM/self-service lead source for Bulgaria and reallocate that effort to direct commercial coverage of UniCredit Bulbank, DSK, UBB, Fibank, Postbank, TBI and ДКУ АД. EOP remains useful only for the public-sector cash-counting, security and POS-acquiring perimeter.
signals.likelihood: Structural — will not change in 6-12 months
signals.followup: Re-scope Bulgaria monitoring: keep EOP/TED for BNB, Bulgarian Posts, Sofia Municipality and NRA; add direct commercial coverage of the private banks and ДКУ АД.

signals.signal: app.eop.bg cannot be read programmatically. Every GET path — /today, /today/<id>, /buyer/<id>, /api/<anything> — returns an identical 7,500-byte Angular shell (HTTP 200, text/html) with no server-rendered content; POST to /api/<anything> returns HTTP 405 for both real and invented paths, so no endpoint discovery is possible. The AOP open-data page www2.aop.bg/e-uslugi/otvoreni-danni-ot-rop/ loads via curl with a desktop User-Agent but returns 403 to the fetch tool, and its data.egov.bg dataset link also returns 403. BNB's own procurement page bnb.bg/AboutUs/AUPublicProcurements/AUPPList/ is a legacy archive that stops at 2020 and states procurement moved to CAIS EOP after 15/06/2020.
signals.source_name: Direct HTTP probes of app.eop.bg, www2.aop.bg and bnb.bg run 01/08/2026; BNB procurement archive page
signals.implies: The only reliable machine-readable route into Bulgarian public procurement is the TED Search API v3 plus the per-notice PDFs at ted.europa.eu/en/notice/<id>/pdf, which carry the app.eop.bg/today/<id> and app.eop.bg/buyer/<id> deep links needed for manual follow-up. Below-threshold Bulgarian tenders (under the EU thresholds) never reach TED and are therefore INVISIBLE without a browser session on EOP — a real coverage gap for small cash-automation service contracts.
signals.likelihood: Persistent until a browser-capable route is available
signals.followup: Give an operator or a Chrome-enabled run the EOP buyer profiles app.eop.bg/buyer/11700 (BNB), /14878 (Bulgarian Posts) and /1240 (Sofia Municipality) to sweep below-threshold notices TED cannot see.

coverage_notes: Fresh run (no checkpoint existed). Target was Bulgaria CAIS EOP (app.eop.bg) with focus on post-euro (01/01/2026) ATM/CDM/recycler/self-service/POS tenders plus BNB own procurement and Borica. EOP itself is unreadable programmatically (see access_issues), so the portal was covered through its authoritative EU mirror: TED Search API v3 with expert queries, then per-notice PDFs extracted locally with pdfminer.six. Search angles used, English + Bulgarian: (1) CPV sweeps for BGR on 30123200 ATMs, 30123600/610/620/630 coin handling, 30132200 banknote counting machines, 30142000, 66172000 card processing, 50310000/50530000/42670000 machine maintenance, 35125100 sensors, 32323500 CCTV, 79713000 guard services; (2) Bulgarian full-text queries: банкомат, банкнотоброячни, монетосортираща, монетоброячна, детектор за фалшиви банкноти, касова техника, ПОС терминал, устройство за самообслужване, АТМ, ресайклър, cash recycler, евро+банкноти, БОРИКА, Дружество за касови услуги/ДКУ; (3) buyer-name sweeps for БЪЛГАРСКА НАРОДНА БАНКА (79 notices from 01/07/2025, 35 from 01/01/2026), БЪЛГАРСКИ ПОЩИ (29 from 01/10/2025), СТОЛИЧНА ОБЩИНА. Twelve notice PDFs were opened and read in full. The headline requirement — post-euro ATM/CDM/recycler/self-service tenders on EOP — returned genuinely ZERO, and that nil result is proved and explained in the two CAIS EOP rows above (exact queries and their TOTAL counts are recorded there). What DID surface instead is the public-sector cash perimeter of the euro changeover: BNB cash-equipment adaptation and sensors, Bulgarian Posts counting machines and CIT, Sofia Municipality counting-machine maintenance, and BORICA's sweep of public-sector POS acquiring. Genuine gaps: below-EU-threshold Bulgarian notices never reach TED and could not be read on EOP without a browser; Borica AD and the commercial banks are private and publish no tenders, so no procurement signal exists for them by construction; ДКУ АД is likewise private and was identified only indirectly, through the justification text of a BNB notice. Baseline items A/B/C/D relate to other countries and were out of scope for this unit.
access_issues: app.eop.bg (CAIS EOP): Angular SPA — /today, /today/<id>, /buyer/<id> and /api/* all return the same 7,500-byte JS shell (HTTP 200); POST /api/* returns 405 for real and invented paths alike, so no backend endpoint could be discovered from main.b1e95fb35f8a74c3.js either. Route used instead: TED Search API v3 (POST api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search, no auth) plus GET https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/<id>/pdf extracted locally with pdfminer.six — worked for all 12 PDFs (system pdftotext still absent on this host). www2.aop.bg/e-uslugi/otvoreni-danni-ot-rop/ — 403 to the fetch tool, 200 to curl with a desktop User-Agent; its only open-data links are two XLSX field-mapping annexes, not the notice data itself. data.egov.bg AOP organisation profile — 403 to both the fetch tool and curl with a desktop UA; logged, not silently dropped. bnb.bg/AboutUs/AUPublicProcurement/index.htm — 200 but a Bulgarian error page ('Несъществуващ адрес'); correct path is /AUPublicProcurements/ (plural), which loads but archives only up to 2020. TED API returns HTTP 429 under rapid querying — pacing of 8-20s between calls was required. Claude-in-Chrome not connected this run.
operator_requests: A browser session on CAIS EOP would close the below-threshold gap TED cannot see. Please sweep these EOP buyer profiles for notices under the EU thresholds, filtering for cash/counting/security/POS: https://app.eop.bg/buyer/11700 (Българска народна банка), https://app.eop.bg/buyer/14878 (Български пощи ЕАД), https://app.eop.bg/buyer/1240 (Столична община). Also worth opening the contract pages https://app.eop.bg/today/533073 (BNB cash-equipment euro adaptation) and https://app.eop.bg/today/439815 (Bulgarian Posts counting machines) for the technical specifications, which name the exact machine models and would let Printec size a service alternative. No paywalled PDFs were encountered.
